author: Praxis II
title: BRBG-AR(interactions, counts-only): B×log_total_counts + DAQB
abstract: Isolate counts covariate: design = [B, B×log_total_counts]; frac_zeros disabled. Ridge l2=1e-3; residualization schedule and DAQB unchanged (λ=0.7, γ_max=0.74; δ=0.15, k_density=20; k=48). Tests whether counts alone are responsible for Cell_cycle degradation.
